# Shri Maha Maya Hotel & Restaurant

Shri Maha Maya is a pure-vegetarian hotel and restaurant on the highway at Pallu, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan, with AC rooms from ₹1,000.

## Key facts
- Name: Shri Maha Maya Hotel & Restaurant
- Address: Main Highway, near Indian Oil Fuel Station, Pallu, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan 335522, India
- Coordinates: 28.938974, 74.216543
- Phone: +91 81073 01306 (call & WhatsApp), +91 96604 01306
- Email: shreemahamayahotel@gmail.com
- Established: 2008 (18 years of service); 10 AC guest rooms
- Google rating: 4.2 stars from 469+ reviews
- Kitchen: 100% pure vegetarian (no eggs); Jain food on request; open 6:00 AM–12:30 AM
- Front desk & room service: 24×7; check-in any time; check-out 11:00 AM
- Payments: cash and UPI; advance of half the room rent or more confirms a booking
- Parking: ample, right off the highway, beside the Indian Oil fuel station; pets allowed

## Rooms (per room per night)
- Standard AC — ₹1,000 — sleeps 2–3 — AC, attached bath, geyser, room service
- Deluxe AC — ₹1,200 — sleeps 2–3 — adds private balcony
- Family AC — ₹1,400 — sleeps 3–4 — two beds, table & chairs; extra bed ₹200

## Dining
- Rajasthani thali ₹140 (dal, sabji, roti, dahi, salad on one platter)
- 71 dishes across 12 categories: paneer, masala, dal, dahi-raita, roti, rice, Mahamaya specials, beverages, salad, parantha, fast food, papad
- Half portions: paneer +₹20, masala/dal/rice/specials/fast food +₹10, dahi-raita +₹5 over half price
- Parcel & takeaway available; no home delivery
